clock: presentation seconds only; no physiological duration or measured trajectory

phases.label: Hypothalamic input
phases.detail: Pulsatile GnRH reaches anterior-pituitary gonadotropes through portal blood.

phases.label: Two-cell steroid route
phases.detail: LH supports theca androgen; FSH supports granulosa aromatase. Androgen crosses between cells.

phases.label: Feedback changes
phases.detail: Sustained high estradiol in the late-follicular context supports the LH surge; this is not a fixed one-number switch.

phases.label: Luteal support
phases.detail: Luteinized granulosa and theca populations produce progesterone and estradiol.

phases.label: Conditional endometrium
phases.detail: Without hCG rescue, steroid withdrawal permits shedding; with established implantation, luteal support persists.

phases.label: Tubal encounter
phases.detail: Capacitated sperm interacts with cumulus and zona before oolemma fusion; ampulla is usual, not exclusive.

phases.label: Activation and pronuclei
phases.detail: Fusion precedes Ca²⁺-linked activation and completion of meiosis II; parental pronuclei are initially distinct.

phases.label: Cleavage and transit
phases.detail: Mitotic blastomere divisions occur as the embryo travels; cell number does not specify exact age.

phases.label: Blastocyst
phases.detail: Outer trophectoderm, inner cell mass and blastocoel are distinct; hatching precedes implantation.

phases.label: Apposition and invasion
phases.detail: Trophoblast attaches to and invades receptive endometrium; implantation is not passive diffusion.

phases.label: Maternal compartment
phases.detail: Maternal blood is outside villi in the intervillous space; the sampled image is a term H&E section.

phases.label: Oxygen/nutrient exchange
phases.detail: Selected solutes cross the villous boundary toward fetal capillary blood; whole blood streams remain separate.

phases.label: Fetal compartment
phases.detail: Fetal blood flows in villous capillaries connected to umbilical vessels, not directly into maternal vessels.

phases.label: Reverse solute exchange
phases.detail: Carbon dioxide and some wastes move net toward maternal blood; this drawing has no measured flux.

phases.label: Cervical remodeling
phases.detail: Effacement and dilation are different changes during the first labor stage.

phases.label: Complete dilation
phases.detail: About 10 cm defines complete dilation in standard staging, not 10–15 cm.

phases.label: Infant birth
phases.detail: The second stage ends with infant birth; presentation and clinical context affect the route.

phases.label: Placenta delivery
phases.detail: Placental separation and delivery form the third stage, distinct from infant birth.
